can be used to boost the wave bonus by up to 10%. This, however, does not multiply the wave bonus by 1.1, instead, it makes the reduction per player weaker. This means that the actual wave bonus increase will in most often end up being higher than what the

lists as the increase. For example, in a quad match where each player adds a 10% reduction, a total value of 40%, Level 20 Stonks will change that 40% reduction to 30%. This boosts the wave bonus by around 16.67%, not 10%. Same method applies to modes like
mode, where there is always a 10% reduction per player, even in solo. If there is no reduction per player, Stonks will actually boost the wave bonus by the value stated.
After a wave ends and every single enemy from that wave has been killed, a wave clear bonus is given. This wave clear bonus only appears in modes after
, meaning it is currently only not present in
mode. Wave clear bonus is a percentage of the wave bonus, with the percentage varying based on the player count.

Once a specific amount of time has passed, a wave skip option will appear. This is a vote menu which lets the player to either vote for the current wave to be skipped or not. In solos, as there is only one person, voting to skip it will do it instantly, while the not skip option simply hides the UI. In duo or higher, all players but one need to vote for the wave to be skipped in order for the next wave to start early.

Wave skip timer can appear at any time, though there are three main and consistent methods. The first is that they will appear after a third of the wave timer has passed. For example, if a wave is three minutes long, the skip option would appear after a minute. The second option is that it appears after 20 seconds have passed. The last option is it never appearing, which is generally reserved for infinite waves.
Players can instantly skip waves if they have the VIP gamepass.

Not good. NOT good. V, watch The Gate! We've just been spotted by some enemies!
Enemies? There's no way. You're so far down inside the Nil Zone's depths that nothing could survive in there. Hold on, we're setting up a portal.
Come on, V! Get us an exit, NOW! If we're surrounded, there won't be a chance to run.
It's too late to backtrack. They've already cut off where The Void's entrance is. Have Hacker send in the recon drones and figure out where we are.
Commander, Narrator told us that this place is hidden deep within the Nil Zone. The rifts act differently at these depths.
That's why we need to study the Void Rifts. If we can figure out how they're formed, then maybe we can also figure out how to prevent them.
There are some insane-looking enemies up ahead. Some of them we can barely see, but — Ugh! Come on! Whatever they are, some keep flying up and destroying all the drones!
I want them out of the sky! Shoot them down!
The gate that's keeping The Void open is recording a downward spike in density. V, are you seeing this?
I see it! If it continues on a downward trajectory, it could end up ripping a massive hole in our realm. There's no way this is natural. There has to be something affecting The Void itself
I found one of Hacker's drones! A chunk of what looks to be glass pierced right through the thing. Whatever it is, it's eating through the metal and starting to grow and—...wait. Listen.
I'll analyze it in a moment and send you the data, V. Whatever these things are that are attacking, they're starting to organize now.
Some of the enemies we've faced have crystals growing out of them. There are even plants sticking out of their bodies. What do you think it is?—
WATCH OUT! *Crash!* — Stupid machine! Ugh! The drone powered on and flew right at me! Whatever it is — it has to be controlling them somehow.
Get down! There's something big heading this way! When is the portal going to be ready, V? We won't be able to hold out much longer!
It keeps failing to trigger! As the density in the area grows, it's crushing the power output of the interconnected portal energizer, which decouples the equilibrium—
[Spanish] I knew I should have stayed at the base.
(Spanish: Agh... sabía que debía quedarme en la base.)
Do you feel that? It feels like I'm being pulled, but I'm not seeing anything!
You can't see them, but your team can. These Phantoms are drawing in whatever's around them. They're like their own miniature black hole. Don't get too close.
Yeah...—uh. Those Phantoms from before? ... There are now three of them.
We're barely holding on here. Is there any chance for backup?
We can't risk it. These enemies might head straight for the gate. And if it closes, the rescue could end up trapped with us.
Do you see that? I don't think these are just random monsters!
Wait a second... That armor. I'll be right back, I—. I have to check something.
Don't let that Titan get close! Keep your head down!
I don't think we're going to make it out of here...
Everything will be alright. Just follow my lead in shooting down those flying enemies. We're getting out one way or another.
Hah. It can be cruel to give someone hope, Commander.
A massive enemy is coming in! Focus everything we have on it before—!
AGH! It got me with a boulder!
Engineer! That's it, COME HERE! AHH!!!
Come here! *Struggling* Get OVER HERE! Ugh! I hate that stupid clown!
You were right. Those aren't random monsters. They just might be what's left of Exo's army, according to Narrator. If that's the case, we have an even bigger problem now.
I can't get you out of there. I'm sorry.
Are you seeing what I'm seeing?
Be careful! We're not sure how much it can do, but it's half the reason why so many enemies are heading in your direction!
You guys need to come back to where you entered The Void. If it closes, I know for certain there's no way for me to pinpoint exactly where you are. And I'll be honest, you're running out of time.
I think there's something around you that's causing The Gate to fail. You either need to run now, or hope you can kill whatever comes next.
I think I broke something. Ugh... Medic is going to be mad.
The drones are picking up more and more enemies heading your way. You need to—
It's too late to run, V. Once we take down this shield guy, we won't stop until we kill whatever's leading them. We're barely hurting them, but we ARE hurting them.
I— I don't know how to tell you this, but I found what's disrupting The Gate. It's almost on you now.
Ugh—...you know what, I'm fine with this. The whole 'last stand' thing. Maybe if I beat this guy I could earn enough brownie points to get the funding for a new build I've been working on.
Follow my lead. Look out for those sword attacks!
Those crystals we examined are emitting the same energy frequency as what's approaching you now. It's as if The Void's energy was concentrated and solidified over thousands of years,
making whatever it touches rip apart.
The research they provide could be revolutionary, but not at the cost of my friends. When everyone gets back, promise we'll celebrate. Alright, Commander?
V, this might be my last message. It's either we're making it out of here, or we don't. Whatever the outcome might be, just know we're making them earn it.
I — Uh. Wait. WHAT IS THAT?

We've got contact inside the Void. I thought this place was supposed to be empty?
What? We've been sending research drones into the Void Rifts for months without encountering anything! Hold on. We're setting up the portal now.
Come on, V! We need a way out now. Engineer, we're heading back.
I'm not sure we can do that. They've already cut off our exit.
Commander, I've set up our ground sensors. V also has Hacker's drones flying in from The Gate.
There are some aerial enemies heading your way!
The ground sensors have also picked up on something too. I'm not seeing them.
It was explained to me by Narrator that the Void is hidden in the depths of the Nil Zone in a place far out of Two X's reach.
We're trying! There's something disrupting the link! From these metrics, it's like the portal is being absorbed before it can even form behind you. I'm tracking the energy drift patterns now!
We haven't had time to set up our defenses!
Not good. Really not good. V, find us a way out now!
It's too late to run, V. I don't know whose attention we've caught, but it doesn't look like it's going to let us leave.
Commander, readings are showing more hidden enemies heading this way!
Find a way through that armor!
So it was you. The ones who freed him. And the ones who freed us from the eons my army has slumbered. And the ones who cut the roots of a false ruler.
Keep your head down and watch for the hammer! V, what's going on here? Answer me!
*Laughter.* Do you hear it? Whispering to you. I do. And it says you will know peace in an everlasting silence.
Something's affecting The Gate! Energy density is condensing into a central point and being pulled inward! The Void is collapsing in on itself, and the structure is barely holding!
Argh! Watch out for the shockwaves!
We're barely holding on. I'm not sure we can go much longer like this...
Hold on! We're getting out of this one way or another. Hold our defenses! They won't get past us!

Why? Why do you fight so hard to leave? There's nothing out there that the silence will not reach eventually. Little by little we tear at the seams of your realms, and slowly we watch as they embrace The Void.
Our world is not for you to destroy! You won't-... no. No! Why are there two bosses?!
Try as the Guardian did to destroy it, we of The Void always have, and always will be... Waiting.
We stabilized The Gate for now, but it won't hold. We're actively searching for this girl's voice, but it's coming up scattered. It's like she's nowhere but everywhere all at once.
Well it's either her or us. I need a way to make sure it's not us. We're running out of options here.
Whatever this thing is, it's barely taking any damage! Wait, did you see that? Right as it uses an attack?
Dodge the attack and shoot it before it recovers, quick!
Where are these souls coming from?
Did you really believe your realm was the first to find silence? *Laughter.*
We're picking up significant cumulative energy nearby. Our sensors can barely track how much is being pulled in and then it's just... vanishing.
The team isn't going to make it much longer. We need a plan B. V, you need to promise me. If we don't make it, that gate closes with or without us.
Just make it out alive, okay?
What is that? Everyone get back! Engie? Engineer! V, it's taking Engineer's soul! I need everyone focusing fire on that monster!
We are freeing them of their burden. To drag them back to flesh and suffering? Only your kind would call that mercy.
*Cough*... If that happens to me again, please kill it quicker. That just felt... wrong.
I need a status update, V!
The Gate is turning into scrap metal and more Void Rifts are popping up. We need to finish whatever 'this' is and leave!
Take cover before it slices us in half! I want all guns on the target now!
The time is upon us. Now, the Void will call out to you. And it will be best to listen as you soon rest your head in a bed of flowers.
When the Old World still drew breath, Lord Exo saw what I was, what I have been always been, and accepted it.
My army marched beneath his banner as I gave him a promise that the flora of the Void would take root in every realm and bloom, until there was nothing left to bloom upon.
Now you will watch as your world dies a quiet, tranquil death.
No. We won't. Because we aren't giving you the chance.
Hah. You carry the will of a fool.
